Reference

How to play

Default controls

You can rebind everything under Controls on the main menu.

ActionPlayer 1Player 2Gamepad
Move / jump / crouchW A S DArrow keysD-pad / left stick
Light (L)FJ or Num1X / □
Medium (M)GK or Num2Y / △
Heavy (H)HL or Num3B / ○
Skill (S)TI or Num5A / ✕
Counter SpurtV; or Num8LT
Throw (L+M)RU or Num4LB
Super (S+H)YO or Num6RB
Taunt (L+H)EP or Num7Back
PauseEsc / Start

Notation

Directions use numpad notation with the character facing right. 5 is neutral, 2 down, 6 forward, 4 back, etc. This means that 5M is standing medium, 2M crouching medium and j.H jumping heavy. 236 is ↓↘→, 623 is →↓↘, 214 is ↓↙← and so on so forth.

Defense

  • Hold back to block, and down-back to block low. Overheads (jumping attacks, hops, dive kicks) have to be blocked standing.
  • Holding back during a dash cancels it, so you can block straight out of the dash.
  • L+M up close throws, and holding back throws backwards. Throws beat blocking. Press L+M as a throw connects to tech it and avoid it. Mashing L+M while you're stuck in a combo or blockstun locks your tech out for a moment. Command grabs ignore L+M, but pressing Counter Spurt as teching breaks it (50 Spurt).
  • Counter Spurt - Press Counter Spurt (V / LT) while blocking. Costs 50 Spurt, knocks them away, and has a 3-second cooldown (the CS chip by your Spurt gauge lights up when it's ready).
  • Backdash (44 / ←←) has invulnerability frames against throws, but not attacks.
  • While knocked down, hold any attack button to get up early or hold 2 / ↓ to get up late. You can't do either after a hard knockdown (throws, command grabs, supers and some skills like Vodka's Full Throttle).

Skills and Spurt

  • Skill motion + L or M gives the two free versions. Motion + H is the EX version and costs 50 Spurt. Without 50 Spurt you get the M version.
  • There's also a shortcut: S, →S, ←S or ↓S does the M version without the motion, but it goes on long cooldown and does 10% less damage.
  • Spurt builds as you deal and take damage. It pays for EX skills (50), Counter Spurt (50), Gold Ship's dash cancel (50) and supers (100).

Combos

  • Normals chain into stronger normals: L › M › H.
  • Mashing L on hit does an auto-combo: 5L › 5M › 5H › skill.
  • Any normal that connects can be cancelled into a skill or a super.
  • After a launcher (2H, or the second hit of 5H), hold ↑ to jump after them for an air combo.
  • The input buffer is 9 frames.

Scaling and limits

  • Damage scaling: the first hit does full damage. After that it depends on the starter (lights start at 80%, mediums 90%, heavies, counter hits and punishes 100%), then drops 13% per hit from the 3rd hit down to a floor of 25%. Supers retain at least 50% damage. The combo counter displays the scaling for the next hit.
  • Juggle points: hits on an airborne opponent cost juggle points (normals 1 and bounces 1, skills 2). At 10 you can't hit your opponent in the air anymore.
  • Ground bounce: j.H in an air combo slams them into the floor and they bounce back up. Only happens once per combo.
  • Wall bounce: some EX knockdowns bounce them off the corner or the edge of the screen. Same as ground bounce, this can only occur once per combo.
  • Projectiles: if you get hit or thrown, your fireballs and Tachyon's potions vanish from the screen. Blocking doesn't clear them, but super projectiles stay.
  • Skill cooldowns: the S-button shortcut puts a skill on its usual cooldown. Doing it with its motion has a cooldown of 10 frames (1/6 of a second).
  • Repeats: the same skill can hit twice in one combo and the same normal four times. Past that the hit passes straight through (you'll see REPEAT) and the combo dies.
  • Hitstun decay: after 2 seconds of combo, hits do less hitstun and juggled opponents fall faster.
  • Combo limit: after 32 hits or 7 seconds, hits pass through and they drop out.

Movement

  • Double-tap → to dash, ←← to backdash. L, M or H during a dash (or →→ + button) is a dash attack: L jab, M lunge, H overhead kick.
  • You can also bind a Dash button in Controls. It inputs →→ for you (← + Dash for a backdash), and Dash + L/M/H does a dash attack.
  • →+M is a hop overhead. You're briefly airborne during this.

Accounts

  • Accounts are optional, guests can play every mode. Make one from Account on the main menu.
  • Settings and progress are saved to your account.
  • Friends: add someone by display name. Once you've both added each other you can see when they're online and invite them to your room.
  • Leaderboards rank players by online wins, win rate and matches. Every online match counts, including rematches and matches against Guests. (This is very finicky right now.)

Training, replays and online

  • Training options (pause › Training options): your and the dummy's Spurt (full, half, empty or normal), health (refill, low or no refill), counter hit on every first hit, dummy throw tech (off, always or random) and dummy wake-up (normal, quick or late).
  • The frame meter shows one cell per frame for both players: green startup, red active, blue recovery, yellow stun, outlined when invincible. It also displays startup and the frame advantage.
  • Dummy recording: 7 to take control of the dummy and record up to 10 seconds, 7 again to stop, then 8 to have it loop while you practice.
  • Combo trials have every runner's simpler wiki combos as challenges.
  • Replays: every Versus, VS CPU and online match is recorded. R on the results screen watches it, D saves the file. While watching, H (or LT) hides the replay controls, and pressing it again hides the whole HUD for a clean view.
  • The tutorial walks through the basics in seven short lessons, from walking to supers.
  • Arcade is seven CPU battles that get harder, then your runner's rival as the final race, then her ending.
  • Online uses rollback netcode and room codes. Hosts can list their room so anyone can find it, and let people watch. While you wait for someone to join, you can use training. The match lobby opens as soon as they join. Both players need the same build, and this wiki is for build 9e9133.
  • Colours: every runner has six colour palettes. Press ↑ ↓ on character select (M in the online lobby).

Special Week is an all-rounder. She has a fireball, an uppercut, an advancing spin kick and an armored tackle.

Contents

  1. Overview
  2. Normal moves
  3. Skills
  4. Super
  5. Combos
  6. Tips

Overview

A bit of everything. Has something for every range: a projectile, an anti-air, a way in and a way out. Few matchups are bad for her, and few are good. Good for beginners.

Special Week has tools at all ranges. Dream Shot covers midscreen, Rising Dream stops jump-ins, Spurt Tornado travels in over low pokes and Last Spurt Tackle armors through a hit or a fireball to gap close.

Strengths

  • A tool for every situation
  • EX Rising Dream is fully invincible
  • Simple combos that end in knockdown

Weaknesses

  • Rising Dream and Tackle are very punishable on block

                      Silence Suzuka is a hit and run character. She aims to get in and out quick while dealing lethal damage quickly.

                      Contents

                      1. Overview
                      2. Normal moves
                      3. Skills
                      4. Super
                      5. Combos
                      6. Tips

                      Overview

                      Hit and Run. Big damage and great escape tools, but low health and not much to do once she's corner locked.

                      M Great Escape runs through the opponent and keeps going, and Silent Flicker kicks and then hops way back, so a lot of her moves are minus on paper but safe because she's out of range.

                      She hits harder than anyone except Teio (×1.1), with a quick dash, a long backdash and the only air dash in the game.

                      Strengths

                      • ×1.1 damage (second only to Teio)
                      • Moves that leave her out of punish range
                      • Air dash and the longest backdash

                      Weaknesses

                      • Below-average health (9,000)
                      • Lead the Pack has short invincibility
                      • Not many defensive corner options

                                          Gold Ship
                                          ArchetypeRushdown

                                          Gold Ship is a rushdown. She has the fastest normals in the game, a command dash with mixups, and Golshi Dropkick!!.

                                          Contents

                                          1. Overview
                                          2. Normal moves
                                          3. Skills
                                          4. Super
                                          5. Combos
                                          6. Tips

                                          Overview

                                          Stay in their face. Fast attacks that are plus on block, and ways to keep going after a blocked string. Wants to start pressure and never stop. Struggles at long range.

                                          5L is 4 frames and plus on block, 2L chains into itself up to twice, and Barrage is plus too. Golshi Rush is where the mixups come from: slide (low), hop chop (overhead), grab (can't be teched) or stop. Dash cancels (→→ after a normal, 50 Spurt) keep the pressure going, though she can't attack for the first 10 frames of the dash.

                                          Strengths

                                          • Fastest normals in the game (4f 5L, 6f 5M)
                                          • Lots of plus-on-block pressure
                                          • Four-way command dash mixup

                                          Weaknesses

                                          • No invincible reversal (EX Golshi Rush is invincible, but it's a dash)
                                          • Golshi Dropkick!! is around −22 on block

                                                          Vodka

                                                          Vodka is a vortex. She gets a hard knockdown, then makes you guess high, low, left, right or throw.

                                                          Contents

                                                          1. Overview
                                                          2. Normal moves

                                                          4. Super

                                                          Overview

                                                          Knock down, make them guess. Gets a knockdown that takes away the opponent's wake-up options, then runs a mixup. Guess wrong and you're back on the floor for another one.

                                                          Everything starts with a hard knockdown: Full Throttle, Pit Stop, EX Drift Hop or EX Drift Drop. No quick rise means they always get up on the same frame, so her setups always line up. L Drift Hop lands in front, M crosses over, meaty 2L is low, Drift Drop and j.M are overheads, and a walk-up Pit Stop beats blocking.

                                                          Strengths

                                                          • Consistent setups after hard knockdowns
                                                          • j.L and j.M cross up
                                                          • Command grab that only Counter Spurt escapes

                                                          Weaknesses

                                                          • Rev Kick isn't invincible on the ground
                                                          • Has to earn that first knockdown

                                                                          Daiwa Scarlet is a zoner. She shoots straight, up, low and from the air, and has a reflector, but she's weak up close.

                                                                          Overview

                                                                          Control the screen. Keeps you out with projectiles at different angles and speeds. Low damage, so she wins by chipping away and never letting you in.

                                                                          Scarlet Shot goes straight (two can be out), High Top Line angles up to stop jumps, Ground Rose runs along the floor and Sky Shot fires down from the air. Rose Barrier reflects projectiles and knocks away anyone too close, back to shooting range.

                                                                          Strengths

                                                                          • Projectiles at four different angles
                                                                          • Reflector that also pushes people out
                                                                          • Long normals and a good backdash

                                                                          Weaknesses

                                                                          • Lowest damage (×0.95) and slowest dash
                                                                          • In trouble once someone gets in

                                                                                            Overview

                                                                                            Make them commit. Waits for you to do something, then makes you pay for it. Struggles against someone patient.

                                                                                            5M and Stayer's Lance outrange almost everything, so walking at her is risky, and swinging at her up close might run into Noble Parry. Her passive, Punish, gives +20% damage and extra hitstun on the first hit against someone stuck in recovery or a long landing.

                                                                                            Strengths

                                                                                            • Stayer's Lance is the longest-reaching poke in the game
                                                                                            • Counter stance that catches high and low strikes
                                                                                            • Most health in the cast (10,500) and PUNISH! damage

                                                                                            Weaknesses

                                                                                            • Not much offense of her own
                                                                                            • Noble Parry loses to throws, and to projectiles unless it's EX

                                                                                                              Tokai Teio

                                                                                                              Tokai Teio is a glass cannon. Her specials chain into each other for huge damage, but she has the lowest health in the game.

                                                                                                              Contents

                                                                                                              1. Overview
                                                                                                              2. Normal moves
                                                                                                              3. Skills
                                                                                                              4. Super
                                                                                                              5. Combos
                                                                                                              6. Tips

                                                                                                              Overview

                                                                                                              Win fast or lose fast. Turns one opening into huge damage, but barely has any defense. Rounds can end in two combos either way.

                                                                                                              After the last hit of one skill, input another and it comes out right away. Each skill can be used once per chain, so a full chain is something like Teio Step › Imperial Rush › Emperor's Rise. Below 30% health, Miracle Mode gives her +15% damage for a comeback.

                                                                                                              Strengths

                                                                                                              • Highest damage in the cast (×1.12)
                                                                                                              • Specials chain into each other on hit
                                                                                                              • Miracle Mode comeback below 30%

                                                                                                              Weaknesses

                                                                                                              • Lowest health (8,000)
                                                                                                              • No invincible reversal without meter

                                                                                                                                  Kitasan Black

                                                                                                                                  From Uma Versus Wiki · build 9e9133

                                                                                                                                  Kitasan Black

                                                                                                                                  Kitasan Black is a shoto. She has a fireball, an invincible uppercut, a spin kick that also works in the air, and a step-in punch.

                                                                                                                                  Contents

                                                                                                                                  1. Overview
                                                                                                                                  2. Normal moves
                                                                                                                                  3. Skills
                                                                                                                                  4. Super
                                                                                                                                  5. Combos
                                                                                                                                  6. Tips

                                                                                                                                  Overview

                                                                                                                                  The classic kit. Easy to pick up, solid everywhere, a little predictable.

                                                                                                                                  Festival Drum is a fireball with quick recovery, Matsuri Uppercut is the best invincible reversal in the cast, Festival Whirlwind goes over lows, and Kitasan Straight is a step-in punch that's barely minus. Fireball until they jump, uppercut the jump, then use Straight and Whirlwind to take your turn up close.

                                                                                                                                  Strengths

                                                                                                                                  • Fireball recovers fast (28 frames total)
                                                                                                                                  • Strongest invincible uppercut (1,300 damage)
                                                                                                                                  • Whirlwind works on the ground and in the air

                                                                                                                                  Weaknesses

                                                                                                                                  • Predictable once people learn her
                                                                                                                                  • Matsuri Uppercut is very punishable on block

                                                                                                                                                      Uma Versus › Characters › Jungle Pocket

                                                                                                                                                      Jungle Pocket

                                                                                                                                                      From Uma Versus Wiki · build 9e9133

                                                                                                                                                      Jungle Pocket
                                                                                                                                                      ArchetypeGrappler

                                                                                                                                                      Back walk2.5

                                                                                                                                                      TraitsThree command grabs, grab super

                                                                                                                                                      Jungle Pocket is a grappler. She has three command grabs, an armored charge and 11,000 health, but she's slow to get in.

                                                                                                                                                      Contents

                                                                                                                                                      1. Overview
                                                                                                                                                      2. Normal moves
                                                                                                                                                      3. Skills
                                                                                                                                                      4. Super
                                                                                                                                                      5. Combos
                                                                                                                                                      6. Tips

                                                                                                                                                      Overview

                                                                                                                                                      Get close, then grab. Command grabs that can't be blocked or teched and do huge damage. Lots of health and armor to get in, but slow.

                                                                                                                                                      Up close you have to guess: block and Pocket Buster grabs you, press a button or jump and her normals and Lion Charge are waiting. Getting in is the hard part. Lion Charge armors through a poke, Jungle Rush grabs from half a screen away, and Wild Catch grabs people out of the air. Her super is a grab that can catch someone in hitstun, so it doubles as a combo ender.

                                                                                                                                                      Strengths

                                                                                                                                                      • Command grabs that can't be blocked or teched
                                                                                                                                                      • Most health (11,000)
                                                                                                                                                      • Anti-air grab and an armored charge to get in

                                                                                                                                                      Weaknesses

                                                                                                                                                      • Slowest walk speed
                                                                                                                                                      • Command grabs whiff on anyone jumping, backdashing or in hitstun, and are very punishable when they do

                                                                                                                                                                          Agnes Tachyon is a set-play character. She leaves potions on the floor that burst later, then makes you deal with them.

                                                                                                                                                                          Contents

                                                                                                                                                                          1. Overview
                                                                                                                                                                          2. Normal moves
                                                                                                                                                                          3. Skills
                                                                                                                                                                          4. Super
                                                                                                                                                                          5. Combos
                                                                                                                                                                          6. Tips

                                                                                                                                                                          Overview

                                                                                                                                                                          Set traps, then fight around them. Strong once her setup is out, weak while she's building it and on defence.

                                                                                                                                                                          Test Tube Toss lobs a potion that stays as a trap, Delayed Reaction sets a flask on a timer, and Catalyst sets every potion off at once. Up to three can be out. Potions arm a moment after they land and burst when stepped on, so walking forward is dangerous and a knockdown next to a potion is a big setup. Any attack or projectile that touches a potion pops it harmlessly.

                                                                                                                                                                          Strengths

                                                                                                                                                                          • Controls where the opponent can walk
                                                                                                                                                                          • Catalyst sets off potions whenever she wants
                                                                                                                                                                          • Strong setups after a knockdown

                                                                                                                                                                          Weaknesses

                                                                                                                                                                          • Low health (9,000)
                                                                                                                                                                          • Slow to set up, and any hit pops a potion

                                                                                                                                                                                              Manhattan Cafe

                                                                                                                                                                                              Manhattan Cafe

                                                                                                                                                                                              Special chain on hit

                                                                                                                                                                                              Manhattan Cafe is a puppet character. Her skills send her Friend to attack from across the screen, but Cafe can't act until the Friend is done.

                                                                                                                                                                                              Contents

                                                                                                                                                                                              1. Overview
                                                                                                                                                                                              2. Normal moves
                                                                                                                                                                                              3. Skills
                                                                                                                                                                                              4. Super
                                                                                                                                                                                              5. Combos
                                                                                                                                                                                              6. Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                              Overview

                                                                                                                                                                                              Fight through the Friend. Her skills send the Friend, Sunday Silence, to attack for her. Lose the Friend and she loses most of her offence.

                                                                                                                                                                                              Phantom Rush charges across the screen, Shadow Sweep is a low, Night Drop falls from above as an overhead, and Rising Shade is an anti-air. Cafe can't act until the Friend's attack is over, so a blocked Friend skill leaves her open. Her strength is where the Friend can reach: full screen with Phantom Rush, right on top of you with Night Drop.

                                                                                                                                                                                              Strengths

                                                                                                                                                                                              • Attacks reach from anywhere on screen
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Low sweep and overhead drop from the Friend
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Friend skills combo off her normals

                                                                                                                                                                                              Weaknesses

                                                                                                                                                                                              • Can't act until the Friend finishes, so blocked skills are punishable
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Hit the Friend and Cafe loses her offence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Dantsu Flame

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  From Uma Versus Wiki · build 9e9133

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Dantsu Flame

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Dantsu Flame is a footsies character. She has fast feet and a long poke that turns into a combo, but she's weak on defence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Contents

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Overview
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Normal moves
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. Skills
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. Super
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5. Combos
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6. Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Overview

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Win the space. Walks in and out at the edge of her range, waiting for you to whiff, then punishes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  She has the fastest walk in the cast, a quick dash and backdash, and normals that recover fast. Flame Thrust is her signature: a long poke that's safe at the tip, and if it hits, press S again for Flame Twist, which launches into a combo. Cheese Wheel rolls in low over a short distance to control the ground in front of her.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Strengths

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Fastest walk speed (4.0)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A poke that turns into a combo on hit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Footwork steps in or out in an instant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Weaknesses

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Fromage Rising only beats air attacks without meter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Needs to win neutral to get anything
